title: astragalus allectus
intro: Astragalus allectus, commonly known as milk vetch, is a plant species that belongs to the pea family (Fabaceae). The plant is known for its potential health benefits, which include immunomodulatory, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant effects. Astragalus allectus is believed to have therapeutic actions such as enhancing immune function, reducing fatigue, and promoting cardiovascular health. Its bioactive constituents include flavonoids, saponins, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
